verdict.rationale: The pack never documents bi-directional sync between Trello cards and a code repository's issue tracker. The Jira item only says users can "view work from Jira in a Trello list", which is a one-way view of a different tool. The GitHub Power-Up appears only in passing in a community comment, with no description of what it syncs. The REST API, webhooks and Power-Up SDK are developer building blocks, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can keep tasks bi-directionally synced with my code repository's issue tracker instead of duplicating data
